title.narrative: Global Microfinance Initiative for Locally Led Action

description.narrative: As an accredited GEF Agency, the World Bank is fully compliant with the GEF Policies on Environmental and Social Safeguards, Gender Equality, and Stakeholder Engagement and their minimum standards.[1] The World Bank has demonstrated that it has in place the necessary policies, procedures, systems, and capabilities to meet these standards. The World Bank has demonstrated that it has in place the necessary policies, procedures, systems, and capabilities to meet these standards. In December 2019, the GEF Council reviewed document GEF/C.57/05, Report on the Assessment of GEF Agencies’ Compliance with Minimum Standards in the Policies on Environmental and Social Safeguards, Gender Equality, and Stakeholder Engagement. The assessment was conducted by experts engaged by the GEF Secretariat and reviewed the alignment between the World Bank’s Environmental and Social Framework (ESF) and other relevant World Bank policies, procedures, guidelines, and systems and the various requirements and the GEF three policies mentioned above. The expert assessment found that the World Bank met all requirements and is compliant with the minimum standards of the three policies. While the team has interpreted this compliance as covering much of the global program’s potential exposure to environmental and social risks, the team has also completed an additional high-level assessment of potential risks based on the official ESRS conducted for the country projects involved in this global program. The compiled view of these risks and proposed mitigation measures has been provided for transparency in Annex D of this Data Sheet. [1] GEF/C.55/07/Rev.01 (http://www.thegef.org/sites/default/files/councilmeetingdocuments/EN_GEF.C.55.07.Rev_.01_ES_Safeguards.pdf)
Note: Disbursement data provided is cumulative and covers disbursement made by the project Agency.
To strengthen the ecosystem for microfinance in selected countries and improve global knowledge and implementation of microfinance in locally led climate and biodiversity action
